market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI peaked at ~$110 in May then fell to $93-100 on US-Iran de-escalation news. Reaching $120 by end of June requires a ~20% rebound from current levels and likely a re-escalation of Hormuz tensions. Goldman/EIA see Brent topping ~$115; WTI typically trades $12 below Brent so $120 WTI is the upper tail of analyst expectations.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether US-Iran deal collapses and Hormuz disruption resumes
